ambiguous-duplicate.json.description: Two candidate windows tie for best score >= 60%

collar-only-single-line.json.description: Single-line comment where line itself was edited but 3+3 collar lines match

cross-side-partial-resolve.json.description: Dual-sided anchor where new side resolves and old side orphans

deleted-file.json.description: Recorded path absent from target tree and no content candidate found

deleted-line-old-side.json.description: Old-side anchor on deleted line evaluated against tree where content has 0 matching score

drift-within-file.json.description: File edited with inserted lines: range shifted to new line numbers

elided-long-range.json.description: Elided long range (omitted > 0) matches head-32 and tail-32 verbatim

elided-range-end-int53-max.json.description: range.end at exactly 2^53-1, the positive edge of the exact-integer bound; arithmetic is self-consistent so the side is well-formed, degrading only because the one-line target file is far shorter than the anchored range

exact-blob-moved.json.description: File moved to new path with identical content

exact-path-blob.json.description: File untouched at recorded path: range and context carry over verbatim

malformed-anchor-decode-both-sides.json.description: Anchor-level decode failure (missing version) with both old and new present; every side present orphans malformed, not just one (WRIT-252 round 6 review)

malformed-before-null.json.description: context.before is JSON null rather than a string array; a null collar array must not decode as an empty array

malformed-blob-null.json.description: Side's blob is JSON null rather than a string; a null must not decode as the empty string (WRIT-252 round 7 fixer mutation sweep)

malformed-commit-null.json.description: Side's commit is JSON null rather than a string; a null must not decode as the empty string

malformed-context-case-variant.json.description: context's lines key is wrongly cased ("LINES"); exact-case object keys are required, not case-insensitive struct field matching

malformed-context-missing-collar.json.description: context carries only "lines", with no "before" or "after" keys at all; none of the three defaults when absent

malformed-context-without-range.json.description: Side carries context with no range key at all; the mirror of malformed-range-without-context (WRIT-252 round 6 review)

malformed-cross-side-decode-new.json.description: Mirror of malformed-cross-side-decode-old: new fails side decode (null commit) and old resolves exactly (WRIT-252 round 6 review)

malformed-cross-side-decode-old.json.description: Two-sided anchor where old fails side decode (null commit, not arithmetic) and new resolves exactly; pins that side-level decode failure is scoped per-side (WRIT-252 round 6 review)

malformed-cross-side.json.description: Old side fails the structural pre-check (elided context shorter than 64 lines) while new side resolves exactly; scope is per-side, so the anchor resolves partial

malformed-elided-lines-not-64.json.description: context.omitted present (36) and arithmetically self-consistent with range 1-100, but context.lines holds only 30 entries instead of 64; step 3 requires len(context.lines) == 64 whenever omitted is present, independently of the omitted arithmetic (WRIT-252 round 6 review)

malformed-empty-lines.json.description: context.lines is an empty array; step 3 requires context.lines to be non-empty (WRIT-252 round 6 review)

malformed-lines-null-entry.json.description: context.lines holds a JSON null entry instead of a string; a null array element must not decode as the empty string

malformed-matching-blob.json.description: Malformed side (short-range elided context) whose recorded path and blob exactly match the target tree, pinning that the Structural Pre-Check runs before Rung 1 (exact-path-blob) rather than after

malformed-missing-blob.json.description: Side omits the required blob key entirely; mirrors malformed-missing-commit for the blob field (WRIT-252 round 6 review)

malformed-missing-commit.json.description: Side omits the required commit key entirely; anchor.schema.json requires commit, path, and blob on a side, so an absent key fails to decode as a v1 side anchor exactly as a wrongly-typed one does

malformed-missing-path.json.description: Side omits the required path key entirely; mirrors malformed-missing-commit for the path field (WRIT-252 round 6 review)

malformed-non-elided-length-mismatch.jso.description: context.omitted absent and context.lines has 2 entries while range covers 3 lines; step 3 requires len(context.lines) == range.end - range.start + 1 when omitted is absent (WRIT-252 round 6 review)

malformed-non-elided-range-over-64.json.description: context.omitted absent and range covers 70 matching lines; step 3 caps a non-elided range at 64 lines regardless of context.lines matching (WRIT-252 round 6 review)

malformed-omitted-int53-boundary.json.description: context.omitted is 2^53, one past the +/-(2^53-1) exact-integer bound, with range and context.lines otherwise well-formed; existing bound vectors only ever exercise version and range.end (WRIT-252 round 6 review)

malformed-omitted-null.json.description: context.omitted key is present but JSON null; presence is judged by key existence, not by a truthy value

malformed-omitted-zero-size-64-match.jso.description: context.omitted is 0 with range/lines sized so omitted == size-64 coincidentally holds (1-64, 64 lines); omitted >= 1 is still required (WRIT-252 round 7 fixer mutation sweep)

malformed-omitted-zero.json.description: context.omitted key is present with value 0; omitted present requires omitted >= 1 and is never reinterpreted as absent

malformed-path-null.json.description: Side's path is JSON null rather than a string; mirrors malformed-commit-null for the path field (WRIT-252 round 6 review)

malformed-range-case-variant.json.description: range's keys are wrongly cased ("START", "End"); exact-case object keys are required, not case-insensitive struct field matching

malformed-range-context-null.json.description: Side's range and context are both JSON null rather than objects; a null must not decode as absent (WRIT-252 round 7 review)

malformed-range-end-before-start.json.description: range.end (3) is less than range.start (5); step 3 requires range.end >= range.start (WRIT-252 round 6 review)

malformed-range-end-int53-exact-boundary.description: range.end is exactly 2^53, one past the +/-(2^53-1) exact-integer bound; unlike malformed-range-end-int53-overflow.json's 2^63, this pins the exact edge of the bound rather than a value any bound from 2^53 up would also reject (WRIT-252 round 5 review)

malformed-range-end-int53-negative-bound.description: range.end is -2^53, one past the negative edge of the +/-(2^53-1) exact-integer bound; existing range.end bound vectors only ever exercise the positive direction (WRIT-252 round 6 review)

malformed-range-end-int53-overflow.json.description: range.end is 2^63, past the +/-(2^53-1) exact-integer bound a JSON number must decode within; start/omitted are chosen so the arithmetic would self-consistently look valid against an out-of-range float's architecture-dependent int conversion, which is exactly why the bound must be checked before converting at all (WRIT-252 round 3)

malformed-range-start-int53-boundary.jso.description: range.start is 2^53, one past the +/-(2^53-1) exact-integer bound; existing bound vectors only ever exercise range.end (WRIT-252 round 6 review)

malformed-range-start-zero.json.description: range.start is 0; step 3 requires range.start >= 1 (WRIT-252 round 6 review)

malformed-range-without-context.json.description: Side carries range with no context key at all; step 3 requires range present if and only if context is present (WRIT-252 round 6 review)

malformed-short-range-elided.json.description: Elided context (omitted > 0) on a range shorter than 64 lines; the resolver ladder must not index into it (WRIT-252 repro 1)

malformed-side-null.json.description: The new side is JSON null rather than an object; a null side must not silently decode as an empty (whole-file, path-absent) side

malformed-single-line-elided.json.description: Elided context on a single-line range against a one-line file; the resolver ladder must not index into it (WRIT-252 repro, index out of range [1])

malformed-version-fraction.json.description: Anchor version is the JSON number 1.5, a fractional value rather than an integer (WRIT-252 round 7 review)

malformed-version-int53-negative-overflo.description: Anchor version is the JSON number -2^53, one past the negative edge of the +/-(2^53-1) exact-integer bound (WRIT-252 round 7 review)

malformed-version-int53-overflow.json.description: Anchor version is the JSON number 2^53, past the +/-(2^53-1) exact-integer bound every catalogue int field must decode within; malformed, not compared to 1 as unsupported-version (WRIT-252 round 5 review)

malformed-version-missing-old-only.json.description: Anchor-level decode failure (missing version) on an old-only anchor; pins that the anchor-level failure orphans old, mirroring the existing new-only vector (WRIT-252 round 6 review)

malformed-version-missing.json.description: Anchor object has no version key at all; a missing version is malformed, not version 1 or unsupported-version (WRIT-252 round 5 review)

malformed-version-string.json.description: Anchor version encoded as a JSON string ("1") rather than an integer; the whole anchor decode fails, orphaning every present side malformed (WRIT-252 repro 2)

rename-and-edit.json.description: File renamed and edited: lines found verbatim in new file

threshold-just-above.json.description: Fuzzy match scoring exactly 60% (6/10) passes threshold

threshold-just-below.json.description: Best candidate window scores below the 60% threshold (5/10)

version-not-1-undecodable-side.json.description: Integer version != 1 alongside a side that would itself fail the v1 side decode; the Version Pre-Check wins over side decode failure

whole-file-orphan.json.description: Whole-file anchor on file whose content changed in target tree

whole-file-resolve.json.description: Whole-file anchor on file whose blob matches target tree
